_about: The day and the weather (src/core/world/systems/sky.js). Hours of the game clock (a day is about 8 minutes of play). dusk: the light goes from day to night between these two hours; dawn: from night to day. rain: chance (the part of the days with rain), start (the earliest and latest hour when it starts), hours (the shortest and longest rain), rise and fall (game hours for the river to rise one block and to go down again). While the river is high, the ford is closed. ambient (src/core/world/ambient.js; the world at rest, with no reward and no count): gust: the gusts of wind (every: the shortest and longest seconds between two gusts; length: the seconds of one gust; delays: the seconds after the start of a gust when it comes to each layer, so that it crosses the paddies, then the hedge, then the trees); meals: the hours of the meals (smoke from the kitchens, steam from the rice pot); year: the days of a year of the game, and the days of Tết in it; rare: the part of the days with each rare thing (from the seed); star: the part of the nights with a shooting star, and its hour; windy: the part of the days with a kite over the village.
